description: Webcams du pont de Saint-Nazaire et des bacs de Loire (temps réel) is a dataset listed in Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Loire-Atlantique. Images des webcams en temps réel de l’état de la circulation sur le pont de Saint-Nazaire et des files d’attente des bacs de Loire (liaisons Basse-Indre - Indret et Couëron - Le Pellerin). Webcam diffusées: Pont de Saint-Nazaire: psn.jpg Bac Basse-Indre - Indret: indre1.jng et indre2.jpg Bac Couëron - Le Pellerin: coueron1.jpg et coueron2.jpg. Coverage: Loire-Atlantique. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are pont, bacs, transport fluvial. The portal shows 5 records. The portal shows 2018-12-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
